title: structured format
name: Structured format — Tidwell
rule: When a strict syntax is required, put that structure into the control (segmented fields or visible separators) instead of a blank box.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Structured Format (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: Strict-syntax values use segmented fields or visible separators.
fail_when: Strict syntax is a blank box plus after-the-fact format errors only.
overview: Encode strict syntax in segmented fields or separators, not a blank box.
apply_when: Values that require a strict syntax users must get right.
not_when: Forgiving-format fields that accept multiple recognizable shapes.
agent_hint: Use segmented fields or visible separators for strict-syntax values.
description: When a strict syntax is required, put that structure into the control — segmented fields or visible separators — instead of a blank box. Pass when strict-syntax values use those structures; fail when strict syntax is a blank box plus after-the-fact format errors only. Structure in the control guides correct entry before submit fails on format.
